scope: Read-only computational risk analysis, without modifying or compiling any Lean source. Edge counts are diagnostic data, not kernel acceptance.
potential_triangle_optimization: Certify an overgraph on unordered vertex pairs with one rejection witness per omitted edge, then prove triangle-freeness of the finite adjacency. Included edges need not be proved actual squares. Keep exact-square rejection only for modular survivors.
potential_closure_optimization: If the closure certificate is the timed-out theorem, explicit checked roots and indexed mutation targets could avoid repeated rootCandidate computations and linear list membership. Requires a generic soundness bridge before concrete use.
